title: The PVD container envelope
description: The data block of a planner document (PATTERN.md, specs/04-versioning.md). This is the schema URI the container names in its own `$schema` field (src/core/container.js). It states the envelope the codec writes and reads; the PAYLOAD below it is the trip model's business, not the envelope's.

payload.description: One trip per document (REQ-201). The trip's own shape is the model's, not the envelope's; this asserts only that a trip is there, because `payloadTrip` and every view read one.

commit.description: Exactly one of `snapshot` or `delta` is stored (REQ-308). Neither is a hash input (REQ-302), which is what makes re-keyframing and compaction free.

operation.description: One patch operation (specs/04-versioning.md §4). `path` is segments; a segment is a name or an index. The forbidden segments are rejected by the walker before a path is ever walked (REQ-706) — that check is code, not schema, because a schema cannot say "not this string" and still be readable.
